core_obligations: Claim the integer n bounding the fibres of f' also bounds the fibres of f.
For a field point x of X with nonempty fibre, use the image containment and points-cartesian to produce a field extension k'/k and a commutative square Spec(k') -> Y over Spec(k) -> X.
Identify Spec(k') x_Y (U x_X Y) with Spec(k') x_{Spec(k)} (Spec(k) x_X U) as schemes.
Transfer finiteness of degree at most n over k' back to degree at most n over k.
proof_roadmap: Setup and claim; image-lifting square via points-cartesian; base-change identification; degree transfer under field extension.
difficulty_reason: A short descent argument whose content is the lifting square plus the displayed base-change identification; the finish is a standard degree transfer.
